# TrendFlow / TrendFlowAI

> Most tools sell post-mortem. TrendFlow sells the pre-flight check.

Desktop-first YouTube Shorts pre-flight analyzer for creators (Agent Swarm by Pragvance channel, ~$10/mo).

## Product
- Pre-flight scorecard for draft YouTube Shorts before upload
- Modes: Study | Test | Trends
- Stack: FastAPI + React, Supabase, Claude + Gemini
- v1 lock: YouTube Shorts only (TikTok expansion held)

## Not
- Not YouTube Studio replacement / post-publish analytics suite
- Not a cold multi-platform viral suite launch
- No fake metrics or guaranteed virality claims
